digest.component_or_area: rebar sidecar channel / gate error telemetry
propositions: The sidecar channel records gate-run request/tool-call limits but omits the actual consumption counters, making cost analysis incomplete from the ticket store.
Five of six emit_gate_error call sites in workflow/gate_dispatch.py pass no diagnostic parameter, failing to capture consumed counters for plan-review and code-review gate errors.
The completion verdict sidecar lacks per-run metrics (requests, tool_calls, duration) while the plan-review sidecar already carries this metadata, creating asymmetry between gates.

The _ALLOWED_FIELDS sanitization allowlist in failure.py admits ceiling fields (request_limit, tool_calls_limit) but drops measurement fields (requests, tool_calls), preventing durable consumption records.
